units.source_text: 源氏想起了三公主，觉得其人实甚可爱，其怀孕之苦毕竟甚为可怜。

en.t: Genji thought of the Third Princess, found her truly lovable, and felt that the hardship of her pregnancy was, after all, deeply pitiable.

units.source_text: 虽然想对她断念，无奈恨敌不过爱，忧伤之余，终于到六条院来探望她。

en.t: Although he tried to give her up, resentment could not overcome love, and in his sorrow he finally went to Rokujo-in to visit her.

units.source_text: 只是见面之后，心中越发难过了，便替她举办种种法事，以祈安产。

en.t: But after seeing her, his heart grew even more distressed, so he held various Buddhist services for her, praying for a safe delivery.

units.source_text: 他对三公主的待遇，大体上同从前一样，有许多地方反比从前亲切而又优厚了。

en.t: His treatment of the Third Princess was generally the same as before, and in many respects it had become even kinder and more generous.

units.source_text: 只是心中已经有了隔阂，总不能开怀畅叙。

en.t: Yet a barrier had already formed in his heart, and he could no longer speak with her openly and freely.

units.source_text: 仅仅表面做得好看，借以掩人耳目，实则心中常怀不快之感。

en.t: He merely kept up appearances in order to deceive others, while in truth he constantly harbored displeasure in his heart.

units.source_text: 因此三公主更加觉得痛苦。

en.t: Because of this, the Third Princess felt even greater anguish.

units.source_text: 源氏并不向她明言看信之事，三公主独自心中纳闷，正像一个无知的孩子。

en.t: Genji did not tell her plainly that he had seen the letter, and the Third Princess was left puzzled by herself, just like an innocent child.

units.source_text: 源氏想道：“正因为如此天真，所以做出那种事情来。

en.t: Genji thought, "It was precisely because she was so naive that she did such a thing.

units.source_text: 落落大方原是好的，然而太过分，就靠不住。”

en.t: Being open and unaffected is good in itself, but when it goes too far, it cannot be trusted."

units.source_text: 便推想世间男女之事，觉得都很可虑。

en.t: He then reflected on the affairs of men and women in the world, and felt that all of them were deeply troubling.

units.source_text: “例如明石女御，过于温柔可亲，天真烂漫，深恐将使柏木之类的色情儿更加动心。

en.t: "For example, Akashi no Nyogo is too gentle, approachable, and innocently carefree, and I greatly fear that she may stir the desire of a sensual man like Kashiwagi even more.

units.source_text: 大概为女子者，如果胸中没有主意而态度一味驯顺，便容易受男子轻侮。

en.t: In general, if a woman has no firm judgment of her own and is simply obedient in manner, she is easily taken lightly by men.

units.source_text: 一个男子看中一个不应该看中的女子，而这女子并不坚拒，那就会犯过失了。”

en.t: If a man sets his heart on a woman he should not desire, and that woman does not firmly reject him, then a transgression will occur."

units.source_text: 他又回想：“髭黑右大臣的夫人玉鬘，并无特别有力的保护人，从小流落在乡间长大起来，然而主意坚定，行为周谨。

en.t: He also recalled, "Tamakazura, the wife of Higekuro, the Minister of the Right, had no especially powerful protector and grew up wandering in the countryside from childhood, yet she was firm in judgment and careful in conduct.

units.source_text: 我对于她，大体上以父亲自居，但心中不无爱欲。

en.t: Toward her, I generally presented myself as a father, yet in my heart I was not without desire.

units.source_text: 她却拿定主意，绝不动心，终于平安无事。

en.t: She, however, made up her mind and never wavered, and in the end all remained safe and uneventful.

units.source_text: 髭黑串通了无知的侍女而闯入其室，她也断然表示拒绝，确是世人所周知的。

en.t: When Higekuro conspired with an ignorant maid and forced his way into her room, she too showed resolute refusal, as the world well knows.

units.source_text: 直到我正式许可，她才肯嫁给他，这就不受私订终身的讥评了。

en.t: Only after I formally gave permission did she agree to marry him, and so she avoided the criticism of having privately pledged herself for life.

units.source_text: 现在想来，此人何等坚贞可佩！

en.t: Thinking of it now, how steadfast and admirable she was!

units.source_text: 她和髭黑二人，宿缘一定甚深，所以能够长久共处，无论如何，永不变更。

en.t: She and Higekuro must have shared a very deep bond from previous lives, and that is why they could remain together for so long, never changing no matter what happened.

units.source_text: 如果她当时被世人看作本人自择夫婿，世人对她多少必有轻蔑之感。

en.t: If people at the time had seen her as having chosen her husband for herself, they would surely have felt some contempt for her.

units.source_text: 此人实在非常聪明啊！”

en.t: She truly was extraordinarily wise!"
